title: Gods of Greek and Roman Mythology
summary: Historical note: until July 2013 individual Greek and Roman gods were LCSH headings with BTs of the form Gods, [Greek or Roman] or Goddesses, [Greek or Roman]. Since then individual gods are RDA name authority records; groups remain in LCSH. Refers to H 1635.
validation_rules: Broader terms for Greek and Roman gods take the inverted forms `Gods, Greek`, `Gods, Roman`, `Goddesses, Greek`, `Goddesses, Roman` (`Gods, [Greek or Roman]` / `Goddesses, [Greek or Roman]`). (H 1636 Background)

Since July 2013, individual Greek and Roman gods and goddesses are established as RDA name authority records, not LCSH; groups of gods and goddesses continue to be established in LCSH (see H 1635). (H 1636 Background)
